roles.role: Duty cycle monitor sample, one per 100 ms pass while algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal.duty_cycle_monitor_enable is set and engine_state is not STOPPED: load factor = (final fueling 0x80d32e - no-load fueling 0x80db1c) x 10000 / (maximum fuel at the speed - no-load fueling), where the maximum fuel is FSMXTHFL (0x80d368) inside the cutoffs DCMNLOES..DCMNHIES and otherwise an ALPHA-blended lookup of two 2D tables at the cutoff speed. It bins engine speed (8 breakpoints at 0x807d20) and load factor (6 at 0x807d34) into region (6 - load bin) x 8 + speed bin (1-48; 49 / 50 for a negative ratio), stores the load factor (0x80bad4) and region (0x80bad6), and adds 1 to that region's dword counter and to the total of the long term map (0x80546e / 0x805398, capped at 3,600,000,000) and of the active short term map (1: 0x80bada / 0x80bacc, 2: 0x80bba8 / 0x80bad0; selector 0x80bad7 from the two totals against the log period 0x800006), stamping each map's start time when its total is 0.
roles.discriminator: The only code in the dumped ROM that writes the three duty cycle monitor map counter arrays, DCMNOPRN (region) and DCMNLDFA (load factor). Its initializer 0xaf70 only loads the two lookup descriptors, the period (hours x 36000) and the stored short term maps; its wrapper siblings 0x26cc8 / 0x26e2c compute percent load words and keep no histogram. 0x800002 (rpm_control_timer_1) is only the low word of the ratio dword 0x800000. The row cm550_slowCycle8Coordinator (0x1b78e) that the family list gives as a second caller is the jsr to this function inside wrapper 0x1b788, not a function.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_updateDutyCycleMonitorLoadHistogram @ 0x50638c - counterpart, not a twin. Same enable bit, STOPPED gate, low / high cutoff clamp, x 10000 ratio, 1-based 8-breakpoint speed binning, the axis word after the last load breakpoint as the ratio when maximum fuel equals no-load fuel, two negative-ratio regions and the 3,600,000,000 cap. Different: CM848 has 10 load bands (regions 1-80, 81 / 82), takes the maximum fuel from cm848_lookupChiMaximumFuelAtSpeed, has no short term maps (blocks 1120 / 1121 are not in its parameter ID table), and adds the percent-time-at-load words and the map reset.

roles.role: Boost pressure in-range high check (the e2m's BIRH), run every 100 ms while algorithm_enable_flags_27_cal.boost_pressure_in_range_diagnostic_enable is set: with engine_state RUNNING, neither boost sensor circuit error (system error bits 25 / 26, masks 0x200 / 0x400 of 0x806002) active and enabled, engine speed at or below the LSG reference speed + DGLSRSOF and percent load JCPCLD at or below DGLWTD, a dwell counter (0x800178) counts to DGBSDCTR; once there, filtered boost above DGSTBSTD counts a debounce counter (0x80017a) up and anything else counts it down. Above DGBSHTTD it sets system error bit 29 (mask 0x2000 of 0x806002 and of the first-occurrence word 0x806042, interrupts masked); at 0 it clears the status bit once the first-occurrence bit is clear; any failed condition resets dwell to 0 and debounce to 1.
roles.discriminator: The only reader of the five BIR constants of e2m block 123D (0x807c04-0x807c0c) and the only code that sets or clears mask 0x2000 of status word 1. The ECU's own tables in the RAM dump confirm the fault: the fault code assignment table 0x80656c maps error bit 29 to fault record 91 = Cummins fault code 433 (PID 102 boost), and bits 25 / 26 to codes 122 / 123 (the boost channel's high / low fault numbers in boost_pressure_sensor_config are 25 / 26). The e2m's DGBSIRHE row (1036 +8) does not match this build. 0x806abe (fault_confirm_status_word_1) is the fault enable bit word (e2m DGFUIDEN), not a confirm status.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_monitorBoostPressureSensorAndUnderboost @ 0x52d6a8 - counterpart, not a twin. Its last block (the boost pressure sensor high reading check) has the same steps in the same order: RUNNING, the two sensor circuit faults clear, engine speed at or below LSG reference + offset, load at or below the limit, else dwell = 0 / debounce = 1; dwell to its limit; boost above the threshold counts up, else down; above the limit set the fault, at 0 clear it (the e2m constants are the same mnemonics, block 1631). CM848 adds the pre-start check, the underboost check and the monitor report in the same body and sets fault 64.

roles.role: Executive frame task set of the every-20-frames group, run in phases 1 and 21 (bsr.w from 0x1b99e and 0x1bc5c; 100 ms): it calls 0xe998 (the boost in-range high check), then 0x4115a and 0x41256, both above the dumped ROM.
roles.discriminator: Phase slot 1 / 21 of the 20-frame group and the only caller of 0xe998. Two of its three callees are not in the dump, so a name by content rests on one callee.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none proven. CM848 runs its boost monitor from cm848_periodicTaskGroup21_calibration @ 0xc000 between the oil pressure task and an EGR orifice temperature check: a different list, and two CM550 callees are unknown.

roles.role: Executive frame task set of the every-20-frames group, run in phases 3 and 23 (bsr.w from 0x1b9e6 and 0x1bc98; 100 ms): it calls 0x491b4 (not dumped; also the single callee of wrapper 0x1b836 in phases 15 / 35), 0xac3c (duty cycle monitor sample), 0x26cc8 (the two engine percent load words) and 0x26e2c (percent load on the low horsepower curve).
roles.discriminator: Phase slot 3 / 23; three of its four callees are dumped. The rows cm550_slowCycle8Coordinator (0x1b78e) and cm550_engineParameterAndBoostControlWrapper (0x1b794) sit on its second and third jsr: nothing branches or points to them.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none. CM848 runs the engine load percentages and the low horsepower percent load from cm848_periodicTaskGroup28_calibration10 @ 0xbdd8 (with two other monitors) and the duty cycle monitor from cm848_periodicTaskSet_outputs2 @ 0xc078.

roles.role: Executive frame task set of the every-20-frames group, run in phases 11 and 31 (bsr.w from 0x1bafa and 0x1bd88; 100 ms): it calls 0x46aac (not dumped), 0x1d9b4 (the idle shutdown state machine), then 0x40b30 and 0x422b4 (not dumped).
roles.discriminator: Phase slot 11 / 31 and the only caller of 0x1d9b4. Three of its four callees are above the dumped ROM. The flags the state machine only reads (0x80d67c / 0x80d67e / 0x80d680 / 0x80d682 have no setter in the dump besides the initializer) must be written up there, possibly by 0x46aac which runs just before it - the code does not show that. Nothing here touches the VP44 pump, so the vp44_ prefix is unsupported.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none (CM848 has no idle shutdown state machine; see 0x1d9b4).

roles.role: The idle shutdown state machine, run every 100 ms while idle_shutdown_enable (flags word 3 bit 1) is set and integrated_idle_management_enable (word 28 bit 4) is clear: a six-way switch on the state word 0x80d674 (e2m ISST) - RESET reloads the timer ISTM (0x80d676) with the period ISTMLM (0x803c02), COUNT decrements it, WARNING sets the yellow lamp request ISWRRQ (0x80d67a) and counts the warning period ISWRTMLM (0x808150), DELAY counts 600 passes down, OVERRIDE reloads the timer and sets ISOD (0x80d672) and the override lamp request ISODRQ (0x80d684), SHUTDOWN sets engine_shutdown_command_flag once on entry. Transitions come from the flags ISRSFG / ISRSWNFG / ISODRSFG / ISODFG (0x80d67c / 0x80d67e / 0x80d680 / 0x80d682), the two option bits idle_shutdown_override_enable and idle_shutdown_temperature_enable, and engine_state CRANKING (SHUTDOWN back to RESET); it ends by saving the state it entered with in 0x800752.
roles.discriminator: The only writer of the state word 0x80d674 besides the initializer 0x1db8a, and the only idle shutdown writer of engine_shutdown_command_flag. It reads no sensor, switch or VP44 data: every input is an idle shutdown flag, a calibration word or engine_state. RESET and SHUTDOWN also clear / set output 30 (mask 0x40 of the output command byte 0x80bcf9) when its override priority byte 0x80bd38 is 0. The other readers of its words are the J1587 status byte builder at 0xefa2-0xf008, the PGN 65252 payload code at 0x33d38 and the lamp blink function 0x249ee.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none. Checked: CM848's parameter ID table has no blocks 10CD / 10CC; its e2m keeps only the calibration leftovers Idle_Shutdown_Period / _Max_IMT / _Min_IMT (0x3fdd4c / 0x3fdd48 / 0x3fdd4a) and no code in ROM or flash2 loads them (lis + displacement scan, .cpp grep); flags word 3 bits 1 / 2 are reserved and idle_shutdown_temperature_enable has no reader; the three writers of engine_shutdown_command_flag are commandEngineShutdown, cm848_updateEngineProtectionShutdown and the engine state code; CM848 only receives PGN 65252 and never reads Jcomm_Idle_Shutdown_Message_Default_Priority (0x3fd862).

roles.role: Start-up initializer of the idle shutdown state machine (jsr from 0x287bc in the application start list): clears ISOD, loads the timer 0x80d676 with the period 0x803c02, sets the state word to 0, clears both lamp requests, sets the reset flag ISRSFG to 1, clears ISODFG and engine_shutdown_command_flag, and clears output 30 (mask 0x40 of 0x80bcf9) when its override priority byte 0x80bd38 is 0.
roles.discriminator: Writes the idle shutdown block 10CD only (plus the shutdown command and output 30) and runs once at start. The row vp44_fuelArbitratorVariablesReset (0x1db9a) is the fourth instruction of this function: nothing branches or points to it.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none (no idle shutdown code in CM848).

roles.role: One pass of a three-flash sequence on the warning lamp (mask 0x2 of the lamp request word 0x80daac): a pass counter (0x801a1a) turns the lamp on in passes 1-5, 24-29 and 48-53 and off in between, sets an in-progress byte (0x801a1c) in the first on phase and clears it and the counter at pass 72. Its caller runs it while the oil change monitor reset flag OCRSFG (0x80dab0) is set or the in-progress byte is set, so a started sequence always finishes.
roles.discriminator: The warning lamp bit (0x2), exactly three flashes, one sequence per trigger with its own in-progress latch; the trigger is the oil change monitor manual reset flag. Its neighbours 0x25316 and 0x25448 flash the fluids lamp bit (0x4) for the oil change due flag instead.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none. CM848 has the flag (oil_change_monitor_reset_flag, e2m 1094 +4, consumed by cm848_updateOilChangeMonitor) but no lamp flash code.

roles.role: The lamp control task, every 50 ms: while the power-up check is in progress (0x8019d2) it runs only 0x24858; otherwise it runs the fault code flash-out 0x24d40, and when that is idle the shutdown warning blinks 0x249ee, and when those are idle the active fault lamps 0x24f30. It then counts passes since start (0x801a22, to 401) and runs the three oil change monitor flashes on their conditions (0x25316 in passes 100-399 with the change due flag; 0x253b0 on the reset flag; 0x25448 with OCRNSTEA 0x803c42, the due flag and engine_state RUNNING), and saves the idle increment / idle decrement / diagnostic switch states (masks 0x20 / 0x40 / 0x80 of 0x80bccf) as the previous states 0x8019eb-0x8019ed.
roles.discriminator: The only caller of all seven lamp functions and the place that orders them by priority; its product is the lamp request word 0x80daac (bit 0 stop lamp, bit 1 warning lamp, bit 2 fluids lamp), which processProtectionFlagConditions (0x23a90) copies to the lamp driver outputs in a different wrapper. It reads no timing or pressure value.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none. CM848's stop / warning / maintenance fault lamp flags (e2m 1094 +6 / +8 / +A) have no writer, its oil change due flag has no reader, and its parameter ID table has no fault flash block 13EF.

roles.role: Executive frame task of the every-10-frames group, run in phases 5, 15, 25 and 35 (50 ms): a single jsr to 0x254b6, the lamp control task.
roles.discriminator: A one-call wrapper. Its current name (cm550_dzgTimingAndPressureSlowCycle10Coordinator) is wrong in its subject: the only thing it runs is the lamp control; the period 10 in the name is right.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none.

roles.role: Power-up output check, the only lamp code that runs until it ends: on its first pass it turns on every output listed in the 16-word ROM table at 0x611a8 (taking each output's override priority byte at 0x80bd1a + n with 0x80 and setting bit n of the output command bytes at 0x80bcf6); after 40 passes it turns the first listed output off, then one more every 10 passes, and after the end of the list and 30 more passes it releases the priorities, clears the in-progress byte 0x8019d2 and zeroes the three previous switch states.
roles.discriminator: The only lamp function that writes the output command bytes and override priority bytes directly instead of the lamp request word, and the only one driven by a ROM list. The list at 0x611a8 is above the dumped ROM, so which outputs it checks is not shown; outputs 0-6 of these arrays are the seven lamp drivers and the function blocks all other lamp logic, which is why I read it as the lamp check. The current name (ioControlMaskStateMachine) does not fit.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none found.

roles.role: Blinks lamps for three shutdown warnings and returns 1 only when none is active: the warning lamp while the idle shutdown warning request ISWRRQ (0x80d67a) is set and the stop lamp while the engine protection shutdown approaching flag EPSQ (0x80d28e) is set (on / off pass counts from ROM 0x611a0 / 0x611a2), and, once the idle shutdown override lamp request ISODRQ (0x80d684) is 1, 120 blinks of the warning lamp (10 passes on, 10 off) after which it clears that request.
roles.discriminator: The only lamp function whose inputs are the idle shutdown and engine protection shutdown flags, and the only reader that clears ISODRQ. The current name (vp44_ioControlLampStateMachine) does not fit: no VP44 data, no I/O control, and no state word beyond three active latches (0x8019e0-0x8019e2).
roles.cm848_counterpart: none.

roles.role: Fault code flash-out: active only while the diagnostic test switch (mask 0x80 of 0x80bccf) is on and engine_state is STOPPED (otherwise it turns the stop and warning lamps off once and returns 1). A rising edge of the diagnostic switch selects the first active fault, of the idle increment switch the next and of the idle decrement switch the previous; in automatic mode (0x80820c) it steps by itself after each code has flashed LCFUFHCU (0x80820d) times. It then flashes the three-digit code word of the fault record (0x8067c4 + 6 x index) through 0x24b4e, or lights both lamps when there is no fault (index 0x7d), and returns 0.
roles.discriminator: The only lamp function gated by the diagnostic test switch with the engine stopped, and the only caller of the fault selectors 0x24c5a / 0x24cd2 and the digit sequencer 0x24b4e. The current name (cm550_faultCodeDisplayController) fits its code.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none (no fault flash block 13EF in CM848's parameter ID table).

roles.role: Sets the stop, warning and fluids lamp requests from the active fault list: for each entry of active_dtc_list it reads the fault record's control bits (0x8067c6 + 6 x index: bit 0 stop lamp, bit 1 warning lamp, bit 2 fluids lamp, bit 3 blink, bit 6 no lamp) and a per-fault inhibit bitmap at 0x803fb6, sets the three J1939-73 lamp flags LCDGSTLP / LCDGWNLP / LCDGFDLP (0x80dab2 / 0x80dab4 / 0x80dab6), and then makes each lamp blink (on / off counts from ROM 0x611a0 / 0x611a2), solid or off.
roles.discriminator: The only lamp function that walks active_dtc_list and the only writer of the three diagnostic lamp flags; it runs last, only when neither the flash-out nor a shutdown warning blink is active. The current name (cm550_activeFaultLampStateMachine) fits in substance, but there is no state word: three blink phase counters only.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none. CM848 names the same three flags stop_fault_lamp_flag / warning_fault_lamp_flag / maintenance_fault_lamp_flag (e2m 1094), but nothing writes them.

roles.role: Flashes the fluids lamp (mask 0x4 of the lamp request word) in groups of three: a pass counter (0x801a18) gives on in passes 1-5, 12-17 and 24-29 and off up to pass 47, then a group counter (0x801a16) counts the group; it stops after 5 groups. Its caller runs it only in passes 100-399 after start while the oil change due flag OCITWNFG (0x80daae) is set.
roles.discriminator: The fluids lamp bit with a limit of five groups and the start-up window: the oil change due signal after key-on. The current name (cm550_faultLampBlinkPatternGenerator) does not fit: no fault is involved.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none (oil_change_monitor_change_due_flag has no reader in CM848).

roles.role: Periodic reminder on the fluids lamp (mask 0x4): it counts 36000 passes (30 minutes at 50 ms), then gives 4 flashes of 19 passes on and 60 off, then starts over. Its caller runs it only while OCRNSTEA (0x803c42, 'enables use of warning light with engine in run state') is nonzero, the oil change due flag is set and engine_state is RUNNING.
roles.discriminator: The only lamp function with the 36000-pass wait and the RUNNING gate. The current name (cm550_periodicLampFlashController) is true but says neither which lamp nor why.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none (CM848 has the calibration word OCM_Warning_While_Running, 0x3fdd62, with no row and no lamp code).

roles.role: Returns the next active fault to flash: steps fault_list_navigation_index (0x8019f2) forward through active_dtc_list (to 1 from 'none' 0x7d or past the count), at most once per list entry, and returns the first fault whose control bits have mask 0x40 clear, or 0x7d when there is none.
roles.discriminator: Forward step; called for the diagnostic switch edge, the idle increment switch edge and the automatic mode. 0x24cd2 is the same loop stepping backward.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none.

roles.role: Returns the previous active fault to flash: the same loop as 0x24c5a with the navigation index stepping backward (to the list count from 'none' or from 1).
roles.discriminator: Backward step; its only caller is the idle decrement switch edge in 0x24d40.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none.

roles.role: The QSPI interrupt handler of the serial EEPROM driver (it ends in rte): clears SPIF in QSM_SPSR, runs one step of the driver (bsr 0x266da) and sets SPE in QSM_SPCR1 to start the next queue pass.
roles.discriminator: It is not called: 0x26854 stores its address in 0x808f20, which is QSPI vector 0x51 in the RAM vector table (VBR 0x808ddc set at 0x2864a; QIVR 0x50 written at 0x2866c). The polled loop in 0x26854 does the same three steps inline before the interrupt is enabled.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_onQspiFinished @ 0x3dcf4 (clears SPIF, then cm848_completeQspiJob) - counterpart, not a twin: CM848's handler serves a job queue shared by every QSPI device; CM550's serves the EEPROM alone and restarts the queue itself.

roles.role: An empty function: a single rts, called once by bsr.s at the start of 0x26854.
roles.discriminator: No code, so no role can be read from it; the only fact is its one caller, the serial EEPROM initialization.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none.

roles.role: Initializes the serial EEPROM driver on the QSPI and loads the EEPROM into RAM before returning: installs the interrupt handler 0x26834, sets up the QSM pins, SPCR0-2 and a queue of a READ opcode (3), an address word and 12 data words, sets ram_refresh_enable to 1, the driver state to 0, the destination to 0x803b0a and the length to 0x148a, then runs the queue in a polled loop (wait for SPIF with the queue pointer at 15, run 0x266da, service both watchdogs) until the loaded flag 0x801a92 is set. It then lengthens the transfer delay, enables the QSPI interrupt, restarts the queue and cuts the length to 0x64c, so the interrupt-driven driver keeps re-reading only the mirror 0x803b0a-0x804155.
roles.discriminator: The only writer of the QSPI set-up registers for the EEPROM, of the destination pointer 0x801a8e and of the two lengths; called once from mc68k_applicationMain (0x28674) right after QILR / QIVR are written. 0x266da is the per-pass step it shares with the interrupt handler.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_initEepromDriverAndLoadMirror @ 0x4cb64 - counterpart, not a twin: the same sequence of ram_refresh_enable = 1, mirror base pointer, full length (0x1a40), loop until the loaded flag, then the shorter refresh length (0x8e8), but through CM848's QSPI job layer and followed by the block checksum.

roles.role: Calculates the percent load on the low horsepower curve SPT0PCLD (0x80db62): when final fueling (0x80d32e) and the low horsepower curve fueling FST0MXFL (0x80d36a) are both above the no-load fueling (0x80db1c) it stores (final - no-load) x 0x6400 / (low horsepower fueling - no-load), else 0.
roles.discriminator: The only reference to 0x80db62 in the dumped ROM. Its sibling 0x26cc8 divides by the 100 percent throttle fueling and by the fuel left on the high speed governor droop line; this one divides by the low horsepower curve fueling and has no clamp.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_validateFuelDemandRelativeToTiming @ 0x50e000 (a misleading old name) - near twin: same inputs and output by e2m record (final fueling, no-load fuel, 105A +2, result 10BF +4), same two tests, same x 0x6400 division, and it also runs right after the engine load percentages in a 20-phase task set. The one difference is that CM848 clamps the quotient at 0xff00 and CM550 stores the low word unclamped, so by the strict rule it is a counterpart; if the clamp is accepted, both could share calculateEngineLoadLowHorsepowerCurvePercent.

roles.role: Calculates the two engine percent load words in 1/256 percent: FSPCLD (0x80db60) = (final fueling - no-load fueling) x 0x6400 / (100 percent throttle fueling - no-load fueling) clamped at 0x7f80, and JCPCLD (0x80db5e), the same fuel over what is available at the current speed (above the high speed governor reference with droop active, the fuel on the droop line; else the 100 percent throttle fueling), clamped at 0x7f80 and forced to 0x6400 while final_fueling_state is FUELING_STATE_HIGH_SPEED_GOVERNOR.
roles.discriminator: The percent load producer: the boost check 0xe998 reads its JCPCLD. Its current name (calculateSpeedRatioComponent) is wrong in subject and is unprefixed although no CM848 row carries it.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_calculateEngineLoadPercentages @ 0x50de54 - counterpart, not a twin: same two outputs, constants (0x6400, 0x7f80, 0x1111, 0x1700) and the governor state 12 override, but the full-load fuel is injection_quantity_combustion_chi_maximum and the zero / droop-inactive cases give different results.

enum_roles.meaning: IDLE_SHUTDOWN_STATE_RESET - timer reloaded with the period, warning request, ISOD and ISODFG cleared, output 30 cleared; leaves to COUNT when the reset flag ISRSFG is 0.
enum_roles.evidence: Case 0 at 0x1da0c-0x1da44 (jump table 0x1da00). PGN 65252 byte 1 for state 0 is 0x00 (0x33d66: idle shutdown timer state inactive). The e2m flag texts name it ('1 - transition to reset from count / warning / override'). Label 0=RESET in the Idle_Shutdown_State record of the CHR_B2 e2m files, whose description is ISST's sentence.

enum_roles.meaning: IDLE_SHUTDOWN_STATE_COUNT - the timer counts down; back to RESET on ISRSFG = 1, to DELAY when the temperature option is enabled and ISODFG is 1, to WARNING when the timer is at or below the warning period.
enum_roles.evidence: Case 1 at 0x1da48-0x1da9c. ISRSFG text '1 - transition to reset from count; 0 - transition to count'. PGN 65252 byte 1 = 0x40 (0x33d6a: SPN 590 timer state active). Label 1=COUNT.

enum_roles.meaning: IDLE_SHUTDOWN_STATE_WARNING - the timer keeps counting down, the yellow lamp request ISWRRQ is 1 and a warning counter (0x800754) counts up; to OVERRIDE when the override option is enabled and ISODFG is 1, to RESET on ISRSWNFG = 1, to SHUTDOWN when the counter reaches the warning period.
enum_roles.evidence: Case 2 at 0x1daa0-0x1daf4. ISWRRQ text 'blink yellow lamp to indicate idle shutdown approach', ISRSWNFG text 'transition to reset from warning', ISWRTMLM text 'time allotted to indicate approaching shutdown'. PGN 65252 byte 1 = 0x44 (0x33d70: timer active + SPN 594 driver alert mode). Label 2=WARNING.

enum_roles.meaning: IDLE_SHUTDOWN_STATE_DELAY - a 600-pass (60 s) countdown (0x800756, loaded in COUNT) before the override; to RESET on ISRSFG = 1, to OVERRIDE at 0.
enum_roles.evidence: Case 3 at 0x1daf8-0x1db20; entered only from COUNT with idle_shutdown_temperature_enable set and ISODFG = 1. The PGN 65252 code leaves byte 1 unchanged for state 3 (jump table entry 0x26 at 0x33d5a goes straight to 0x33d80). Label 3=DELAY (CHR_B2 also has Idle_Shutdown_Delay_Flag 'transitioning to delay before override or warning'). The name comes from that label; the code shows only the timed wait.

enum_roles.meaning: IDLE_SHUTDOWN_STATE_OVERRIDE - the timer is held at the period, the warning request is cleared, ISOD and the override lamp request ISODRQ are set; to RESET on ISODRSFG = 1.
enum_roles.evidence: Case 4 at 0x1db22-0x1db46. ISOD text 'idle shutdown is overridden until vehicle moves', ISODRQ text 'blink yellow lamp to indicate idle shutdown is overridden', ISODRSFG text 'transition to reset from override'. PGN 65252 byte 1 = 0x10 (0x33d76: SPN 592 timer override). Label 4=OVERRIDE.

enum_roles.meaning: IDLE_SHUTDOWN_STATE_SHUTDOWN - on entry (previous state 0x800752 not 5) clears the warning request, sets engine_shutdown_command_flag and output 30; back to RESET when engine_state is CRANKING.
enum_roles.evidence: Case 5 at 0x1db48-0x1db7c. PGN 65252 byte 1 = 0x01 (0x33d7c: SPN 593 idle shutdown has shut down engine); the J1587 status byte sets mask 0x02 when the shutdown command is set and the timer is 0 (0xefe8-0xeff8). Label 5=SHUTDOWN.
